bayts.text: O Allah, bless and grant peace perpetually, on my behalf, upon the best of creation, Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and grant me a secret for which those before me holily envy me.
And bless, O All-Merciful, perpetually, the best Prophet and Messenger, who has risen high,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me, today and after today, the protection of all of me from misery and reproach.
And turn away what draws misery and reproach toward others than my person, O Preserver, O Peace.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon the Hashimite Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And spare me the adversities of the two Abodes, O You Who spare from the two fires and the two disgraces.
And make my heart, for You, O Everlasting, more beloved than the books sent down from the most Beloved.
And make my writing a leader to You, and make my life a benefit for the Prophet.
And make through him, after blessing and peace upon him, my writing such that it dispels every darkness.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "All-Knowing" (Al-ʿAlīm) and "All-Aware" (Al-Khabīr),
bless with a blessing accompanied by glad tidings, with Your peace, him who received the glad tidings,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my letters, through him, the best of vessels, O best of those whom a servant has called upon with letters.
And make my letters deferred miracles and the best of goods treasured with You.
And grant me today, through him, the "Be!" and it is, in repelling and drawing, and make rest good for me,
without calamity and without deprivation, forever; and overcome my adversaries for me.
And make clear for me, O my Sovereign, my breaths, O You Who spare from enemies and oppressors.
O best of hosts and best of providers, O my Preserver, O You Who host me, O You Who provide for me,
bless with a blessing accompanied by abundance the Prophet and Messenger, possessed of abundance,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me, forever, that I am grateful to You for (all) that thanksgivings have obtained,
and that I see none but You, O You Who place my desire within Your will,
and that to You, through the Chosen, I have turned all of me: You have kept for me what I chose.
Perpetually, then, on my behalf bless with peace him, in the Family and with the Companions, O Peace (As-Salām).
And bless, O All-Knowing, with the most excellent blessing, with Your peace, him who spares from haters,
driving them all toward others than me; and that is the Intercessor, "an ear of good" (Qurʾān 9:61).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bless, O All-Aware, with the most beneficial blessing, him whose loftiness I manifest through my service,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my sheets, through him, and my pen the best of worship and the best ladder.
To You (I owe) a service that gladdens the best of Prophets: my breast is gladdened (by it).
And bless, O Bestower, perpetually, the best intimate and beloved, who has risen high,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today wonders that last, without guile: truly You are the Everlasting, the Eternal.
And spare me wrath and delusion in everything, and spare me the Deceiver (Qurʾān 31:33).
And grant me the gathering of what has been scattered among the chosen, out of generosity; and separate
between me and everything that draws (harm), toward the best of Your good pleasure; and make the favours good for me.
The Able (Al-Qādir), the All-Powerful (Al-Muqtadir), has spared me what destiny contains of toil.
A Sufficing One has driven what grieves toward a direction other than mine, Who has spared me everyone who did evil.
I have gladdened the best of creation with a lasting joy: truly I am to him beloved, intimate and servant.
The All-Powerful has made easy for me what was hard for others than me, and explained right guidance to me.
The Generous, the Honourer, has honoured me, and led me with His honoured Remembrance.
The beauty of a beneficent Everlasting One has come to meet me, and permanence and benefits have yielded to me.
The All-Powerful has drawn out blessing for me, and no turbidity comes toward my person.
O Allah, bless and grant peace perpetually upon the Intimate and Beloved, Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and bring into being for me my aim, without harm, that it may be.
